selectionRule: Highest development mean exact full-six joint log-gain, including uniform; ties follow listed model order.
singleAggregation: Arithmetic mean of p/(6/45) over the six current-source antecedents and all included lags.
pairAggregation: Arithmetic mean of p/(6/45) over current-source pairs with training support >= 8 across lags 1,2,3; uniform fallback if no pairs qualify.
similarity: At each lag L, historical source similarity is C(overlap with current source, 2)/15; use weighted target counts and weighted support with prior strength 80, then mean the three lag ratios.
trainingConstraint: For prediction index t and lag L, current source is t-L; every historical source s has s+L<t.
distribution: P(S)=product_{n in S}(w_n)/ESP6(w), unordered six-element sets.
secondaryMetric: Mean of 45 exact-marginal squared errors; lower is better. Top-six match histogram, weights descending and number ascending for ties.
limitations: Final 104 historical draws were inspected in prior experiments; this is exploratory reuse, not a fresh holdout.
99.1667% intervals for six alternatives are only an approximate Bonferroni family-wise adjustment; block bootstrap coverage and post-selection effects remain approximate.
No hyperparameter tuning or model redefinition after scores are viewed.
mixture: Exact equal mixture of normalized unordered-ticket distributions of uniform and the five temporal models. P_mix(S)=sum(P_component(S))/6. Marginals are means of component marginals. Joint score uses logsumexp of component log-probabilities, never averaged weights.
